lines.text: Every night, your body does five strange things, and you never notice a single one.
One: it paralyzes you. During dream sleep, your brain shuts off almost every muscle, so you don't act out your dreams.
Two: your brain takes a bath. Fluid washes through it, flushing out the waste that builds up while you're awake.
Three: you grow taller. With no weight pressing down, the discs in your spine expand. You wake up about a centimeter taller.
Four: your nose stops guarding you. Smell almost never wakes a sleeping person, which is exactly why you need a smoke alarm.
Five: that sudden falling jolt? It's a hypnic jerk, your muscles twitching as you slip into sleep.
So tonight, when you close your eyes, remember:
